title: Sprite has occasional flickering of pixels from neighboring frames
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e]. Can't be bothered to remake all the animations when backporting this thing to 4.5 and earlier, but the very fact that the animations break when trying to open it in an earlier version makes me think it's a 4.6 exclusive regression. Definitely wasn't a thing when I was only starting out porting my game to 4.x. ### System information Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.3667) - AMD Ryzen 7 3750H with Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx (8 threads) - 15.81 GiB memory ### Issue description When my character is playing an animation (mostly jump-related ones), there's occasional flickering above his head (see video below). Examining the freeze frames makes me suspect the flickering is from the frame located directly above in the sprite sheet, because the position of the pixels in this one row directly corresponds to where the bottom of his shoes is in the frame above. In the editor, the animation plays normally without issues. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d0befb32-b5d0-4b28-8186-996e8bab41de (ignore the missing background, that's not part of the bug, that's me waiting for 4.7 with its support for atlases in texture rects) Freeze frame: Part of spritesheet to compare: ### Steps to reproduce ??? I myself have no idea how this happened. Grab the same sprite sheet and make the same animations/tree structure/whatever? ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I tried to make one but I can't seem to reproduce the bug 😖 Maybe it's not dependent on the player's code but on some other part of my complicated thing
